review_requirements: Resolve the protocol/SAP masking conflict: protocol physical pages 3 and 5 call the trial single-masked and leave surgeons unmasked, while SAP physical page 2 calls it double-masked and says participating surgeons and participants are masked.
Resolve the protocol physical page 7 six-month primary IOP endpoint against the SAP physical pages 2-3 twelve-month primary IOP endpoint before freezing the endpoint hierarchy.
Define the primary linear-regression estimand, missing-data rule, covariate coding, center handling and analysis population without treating the registry actual enrollment as the prospective target.
Define multiplicity and time-to-failure details and distinguish the descriptive safety interim review from a formal efficacy stopping analysis.
Verify all critical locators against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages during independent review.
